title: Rehum
sourceLines: -1. A captive who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon Ezr 2:2
-2. A chancellor who wrote a letter to Artaxerxes, influencing him against the Jews Ezr 4:8,9,17,23
-3. A Levite who repaired part of the wall of Jerusalem Ne 3:17
-4. A Jew of the exile who signed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:25
-5. A priest who returned to Jerusalem from the captivity in Babylon Ne 12:3
